images.name: the-hangover
images.alt: A Google Maps route from Denver down through Colorado and New Mexico to Silver City, with a bleary-eyed cartoon Gravel God holding a coffee over Arizona.
images.note: The original had him smoking a cigar; the rig has no cigar, so he holds a coffee instead.

images.name: road-trip
images.alt: Inside a car on a road trip: a woman in the back seat and a toddler in a car seat, with cartoon Gravel God's face peeking in from the right edge.
images.note: The original was a short animation; the redraw is a still.

images.name: untitled-design-1
images.alt: A tweet from Chris Bianchi (@BianchiWeather): "With no snow in the forecast, it looks likely Denver will have - by far - its shortest snow season on record (97 days)." A Denver (DIA) stats card reads first measurable snow Dec. 10, last measurable snow Mar. 17, 97 day snow season; cartoon Gravel God shrugs in front of it.

images.name: untitled-design
images.alt: A big family lunch at a long patio table, kids and grown-ups smiling at the camera, with cartoon Gravel God's head on one of the men at the back.

images.name: las-vegas-fire
images.alt: Cartoon Gravel God, seen from behind beside a wooden power pole, looks across dry grassland to wildfire smoke rising over the hills.
